item.title: Southport firefighters enjoy snowy fun with kids at waterfront
item.description: Firefighters in Southport traded hoses for snowballs as they joined kids and families for some snowy fun along the waterfront.

item.title: More winter weather leads to heavy snow, canceled flights and, in Florida, falling iguanas
item.description: A huge swath of the U.S. from the Gulf Coast into New England was mired in extra-cold temperatures Sunday after a bomb cyclone brought heavy snow and hundreds of flight cancellations to North Carolina, flurries and falling iguanas in Florida, and more misery for thousands who are still without power from last weekend's ice storm in the South.

item.title: Winter weather causes flight cancellations and delays at Wilmington International Airport
item.description: Winter weather from the recent snowstorm has led to numerous flight cancellations and delays at Wilmington International Airport, according to the airport’s online arrivals and departures web page.

item.title: Unplowed roads, low traffic mark early morning after overnight snowfall
item.description: Overnight snowfall left much of the Cape Fear region covered in inches of snow, creating hazardous and largely impassable road conditions Tuesday morning.

item.title: Longwood, Ocean Isle Beach report heaviest snowfall as storm blankets Brunswick County
item.description: Parts of Brunswick County appear to have taken the hardest hit from the winter storm, with some communities reporting well over a foot of snow.

item.title: Snow day draws sledders to Ann Street in downtown Wilmington
item.description: Fresh snowfall transformed downtown Wilmington into a rare winter scene, drawing residents to Ann Street for an unusual snow day in the Port City.

item.title: Towns in Brunswick County get some of the most snow it has seen in years
item.description: From Ocean Isle Beach, to Longwood, rural areas in Brunswick County got some of the most snow it has seen in years, with some areas getting over 10 inches of snow.

item.title: From snow to ice: Wilmington snow plow crews worry for freezing conditions
item.description: Perhaps one of the most popular and in-demand people following a snow event like the one we just experienced are businesses that offer “snow clearing” or “snow plowing.”

item.title: WWAY viewers capture images of rare snow event in the Cape Fear
item.description: Based on the numerous photos and videos that many viewers sent to WWAY, lots of people were outside on Sunday, enjoying a walk or playing in the snow.

item.title: New Hanover County official gives update on winter storm’s effect on the area
item.description: Even with the sun coming out on Sunday and melting some of the snow and ice, most people stayed off the roads unless travel was necessary.
